text.p: - Slovenian Foreign Minister Zoran Thaler said during the 53th session of the Human Rights committee in Geneva that Slovenia strongly supports activities of the International Court for War Crimes in former Yugoslavia.
- Slovenian ski-jumper Primoz Peterka extended his overall World Cup lead after winning a third place in Finland's Kuopio on Wednesday.
- Ministry of Economic Activities and Development signed a trade agreement with Egypt. Last year Slovenia's exports to Egypt amounted to $26 million while imports totalled eight million dollars.
- Joze Stanic, general manager of domestic appliances producer Gorenje was elected as the new president of Slovenia's Association of Employers.
- Since the beginning of 1995, there were seven major cases of money-laundering discovered in Slovenia, the country's financial institutions said.
- Defence Minister Tit Turnsek said that joining NATO would be the priority of his ministry.
